author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
An interview candidate said he would like to start after new year, I ask why. He said he wanted to finish the project he is working on before leaving.
I told him after you have a new job, you should always start ASAP, do the legal minimum hand off, then take the refresh break. You shouldn't worry about your old company, it is NOT your problem any more.
And if for whatever reason, our stock price crashed 50%, given how the tech and wall Street works, the offer is very likely will be withdrawn. Why take the risk?
